calls.statement:
SELECT join_date, count(*) versions, count(distinct member_id) members, min(valid_from), max(valid_from)
FROM dim_member WHERE join_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-20' AND DATE '2026-09-30' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT max(join_date), max(sale_date_max) FROM dim_member, (SELECT max(sale_date) sale_date_max FROM fact_sales_line)

WITH fv AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY member_id ORDER BY valid_from, member_key) rn FROM dim_member)
SELECT home_store_id, count(*) n, count(distinct member_id) m, min(valid_from), max(valid_from), min(tier), max(tier)
FROM fv WHERE rn=1 AND join_date=DATE '2026-09-25' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT count(*) total_versions, count(distinct member_id) members, count(distinct member_key) keys,
 sum(CASE WHEN valid_from < join_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) vf_before_join,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM stg_member_updates WHERE join_date=DATE '2026-09-25') stg_rows
FROM dim_member WHERE join_date=DATE '2026-09-25'

WITH ids AS (SELECT DISTINCT member_id FROM dim_member WHERE join_date=DATE '2026-09-25')
SELECT count(*) members_on_date, (SELECT count(*) FROM dim_member m JOIN ids USING(member_id)) all_versions,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT member_id FROM dim_member GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(distinct join_date)>1)) members_with_changing_join_date
FROM ids
